message: Autoresearch goal created: ARIA-NBV Python standards and aria_nbv package guidance source-of-truth audit

evidence: The research artifact aggregates current Python and aria_nbv package standards, identifies redundant and stale sources, uses litkg/KG and code-index evidence, includes external best-practice checks, explains the reimplementation failure mode, and ranks source-of-truth streamlining actions by ROI and urgency.
